title: Medical Implants
description: Small precision part, complex curved surfaces (articular), hex/cross drive, self-tapping thread
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 23 ELI (ASTM F136) is the standard for surgical implants. Extra-low interstitials (O<=0.13%) improve fracture toughness. Do not substitute industrial TC4.
Form: Bar is the standard form for bone screws/plates. Single-setup Swiss turning, good surface quality, batch consistency.
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM F136, Annealed, 100% dimensional inspection + surface contamination test, sterile packaging
